writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Plant Your Own Tomato: Saturday Workshop

Spring's heat has arrived, and it's time to start tomatoes. Join us Saturday, June 14, at 9:30 a.m. in the garden's south plot for a hands-on planting workshop led by longtime gardener Rosa Delgado.

We'll cover choosing the right variety for your space, soil preparation, transplant timing, spacing, staking, and how to water deeply without wasting a drop. The advice suits raised beds, containers, and small backyards alike.

Everyone leaves with two seedlings, a printed care guide, and a summer garden plot assignment. Gloves and tools are provided; bring a hat, water bottle, and sturdy, comfortable shoes.

Registration is free, but space is limited to twenty gardeners. Sign up at the library front desk. We'll see you under the sun.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
